title: Wiki Curator Verdict
description: Receipt summarizing what the wiki-curator skill changed.

pages_merged.description: Pages consolidated into another page of the same kind and class or entity.

claims_fixed.description: Stale claims updated or removed because a contradicted page was wrong.

pages_deleted.description: Pages deleted because they were empty or duplicates.

index_updated.description: Whether index.md or examples/README.md was updated to match the file tree.

log_trimmed.description: Whether older log.md entries were summarized into an archive.
